sentences.en: A son was born to Juha after a year.
The whole village came to bless him.
They sat in the yard and drank coffee.
One asked: when exactly was he born?

sentences.ar: האיש אמר: אבל התחתנת לפני שנה.
sentences.en: The man said: but you married a year ago.

sentences.ar: האיש אמר: אז זה לא מסתדר.
sentences.en: The man said: then it does not fit.
Juha took paper and a pencil.
He said: let us calculate together.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אני נשוי שנה שלמה.
sentences.en: He said: I am married a whole year.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: וגם אשתי, שנה שלמה.
sentences.en: He said: and my wife also, a whole year.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: וגם הבן, שישה חודשים.
sentences.en: He said: and the son also, six months.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: שנה ושנה זה שנתיים.
sentences.en: He said: a year and a year is two years.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: ועוד חצי, זה יותר.
sentences.en: He said: and another half, that is more.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אז מה הבעיה בדיוק?
sentences.en: He said: so what exactly is the problem?
Everyone was silent and drank the coffee.
